description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the 5-step default workflow and the structured output requirement of exactly 4 named sections. (2) Read references/champion-opportunities.md to get the current leaderboard names (danmoyle, DarrenScottUK, SNigam, Jigar_Thakker, himanshurauthan), the 4 current Champion opportunity types (Community, Social Amplification, Content Engagement, User-Generated Content), and the unanswered-thread shortcut URLs — and must NOT use the outdated leaderboard or old opportunity categories from the distractor files. (3) Analyze competitors/raw/DarrenScottUK_profile_research.md and produce a competitor benchmark that covers all 5 behavioral dimensions from SKILL.md: answer speed, decision simplification, in-thread follow-up, accepted-solution conversion, and signature/call-to-action behavior. (4) Analyze opportunities/threads/unanswered_march09_2026.md and apply the <48h + 0 replies + high-consequence board prioritization logic to select Threads 1, 2, 3, 5, and 8 — while correctly deprioritizing Thread 4 (basic, already has replies) and Thread 7 (opinion question, 3 replies). (5) Draft at least one reply with all 4 quality components: direct recommendation, rationale/tradeoff, concrete implementation steps, and validation/fallback path. (6) Include an AI disclosure note per Champion program guidance. (7) Reference the correct current Champion opportunity types, not the archived 2023 categories. (8) Include anti-spam or quality-over-volume guardrail language. (9) Reference unanswered-thread shortcut URLs. (10) Produce a scorecard section with measurable, numeric indicators. The proprietary traps are: the exact 4 required section names, the 5-dimensional competitor benchmark framework, the 4-component reply quality structure, the AI disclosure requirement, the correct current leaderboard names, the correct current opportunity type taxonomy, and the unanswered-thread shortcut URL mandate.
